Discover

Our ethos

We live in the most complex world in history. Never before have companies faced so many challenges – and never before have they had so many opportunities.‍We are experts in strategic design and your partner in this new world. With all our knowledge and experience, we unlock the full potential of your brand.‍Let’s explore new paths together to achieve something truly unique.

Learn more

Our approach

We build brands that are future-proof and set up for success. With a unique approach and deep expertise, we create strategies that go beyond the ordinary—turning challenges into opportunities and visions into reality.

01

Mastering Complexity

We specialize in brands facing high complexity—whether they have extensive product portfolios or offer intricate, explanation-intensive products and services. Our expertise helps bring clarity and structure to even the most challenging brand landscapes.

Write us

02

Strategic Brand Guidance

We see ourselves as a partner who brings together the many factors required for brand success. From the very beginning, we provide an external perspective that identifies potential, streamlines communication, and helps brands focus on what truly matters.

Write us

03

AI-Powered Precision

By leveraging the AI-driven market research tool Brainsuite from Aimpower, we refine our designs before they even reach the client. This ensures their effectiveness and allows us to measure whether they outperform previous designs—optimizing impact before execution.

Write us

04

Sustainability Expertise

We have extensive experience in communicating sustainability topics effectively. From strategy to execution, we translate complex environmental and social narratives into compelling, authentic brand communication that resonates.

With "beige ist besser", we've developed an award-winning 360° campaign for WEPA that brings circular economy into everyday life and that shows how an explanatory product can become a strong communication platform with a clear point of view.

Show case

mach m!t is one of Germany’s leading brands for eco-friendly hygiene paper. We completely redesigned the brand — from corporate identity to strategic repositioning across all media.

Show case

For Giorgio Armani, we developed high-end CRM initiatives presented in elegant collector’s boxes. These designs blend minimalist aesthetics with informative elegance, enhancing anticipation for the luxury products.

Show case

Satino offers stylish dispensers and sustainable hygiene paper for businesses. Since 2020, we have been supporting the brand with international campaigns, product staging, and multimedia trade show appearances.

Show case

For Satino Hyginity, the curved dispensers designed for sustainable restrooms, we've created a comprehensive campaign in which we've used CGI renderings to highlight the unique blend of cutting-edge technology and an extraordinarily aesthetic feel.

Show case

Our collaboration with Katjes began almost at the same time as KRAVT’s founding. Since then, we have realized numerous projects — including many of the vibrant packaging designs that define the brand.

Show case

WEPA is one of Europe’s leading hygiene paper manufacturers and is committed to sustainability. Since 2019, we have been the company’s lead creative agency, shaping its brand communication.

Show case

The L’Oréal Advent Calendar is a bestseller in German drugstores. With a premium, eye-catching design, its retail price has nearly tripled — making it a highly sought-after collector’s item.

Show case

Ahoj-Brause is now much more than its iconic sherbet powder. With an expanding product range, we have carefully evolved the branding — modernizing the logo and introducing 3D renderings to enhance its presence in the confectionery aisle.

Show case

After more than 30 years, we gave this renowned German film and television production company – specializing in auteur films – a minimalist yet striking rebrand, enhancing its brand recognition across all touchpoints, from logo to corporate stationery.
